franklin.name: Franklin
franklin.commentary: Franklin is rated a balanced market as of August 31, 2026, based on rolling 3-month figures. The sources differ: Zillow's index reads neutral at 46 and Realtor.com's Williamson County hotness score reads cool at 41.7 of 100, while Redfin's 3.6 months of supply reads as a seller's market. Zillow's index is down 6 points over three months, and the median sale price of $862,929 is up 12.4% from a year earlier.
